        environment.pop(key,None)
environment.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1', GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GOMAXPROCS='2')
def git(*args, repo=REPO):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),*args],env=environment)
def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def blob(ref,path,repo=REPO):
    return git('show',ref+':'+path,repo=repo)
def tree(ref,*paths):
    return git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',ref,'--',*paths).decode().splitlines()
forbidden = {'.git','.env','node_modules','__pycache__','build','.cache','browser-state','cookies','credentials'}
assert FILE.stat().st_size == 2223215
assert sha(FILE.read_bytes()) == '1d092ae10c9b3d20afc03eb9e784ff69d806bc12e6cf0da14ed0461783fae653'
with zipfile.ZipFile(FILE) as archive:
    infos = archive.infolist()
    names = [i.filename for i in infos]
    assert len(set(names)) == len(names) == len({n.casefold() for n in names})
    for info in infos:
        p = PurePosixPath(info.filename)
        assert p.parts[0] == ROOT and len(p.parts) > 1 and not p.is_absolute()
        assert str(p) == info.filename and '\\' not in info.filename and ':' not in info.filename and '\0' not in info.filename
        assert all(part not in ('','..','.') and part.lower() not in forbidden and not part.lower().startswith('.env') for part in p.parts)
        assert not info.is_dir() and not info.flag_bits & 1
        mode = info.external_attr >> 16
        assert info.create_system == 3 and stat.S_ISREG(mode) and stat.S_IMODE(mode) == 0o644
        assert 0 < info.file_size < 3000000
    assert sum(i.file_size for i in infos) < 40000000
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    data = {i.filename[len(ROOT)+1:]:archive.read(i) for i in infos}
    manifest = json.loads(data['MANIFEST.json'])
    assert manifest['self_excluded'] == ['MANIFEST.json']
    rows = manifest['files']
    assert len({r['path'] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
    assert {r['path'] for r in rows} == set(data)-{'MANIFEST.json'}
    identity = json.loads(data['SOURCE_IDENTITY.json'])
    assert identity['project_commit'] == HEAD and identity['tested_source'] == SOURCE and identity['base'] == BASE and identity['openfhe_commit'] == PIN
    verified = []
    for row in rows:
        name = row['path']; value = data[name]; origin = row['origin']
        assert (len(value),sha(value)) == (row['bytes'],row['sha256'])
        kind = origin['kind']
        if kind in ('project-git','official-git'):
            upstream = UPSTREAM if kind == 'official-git' else REPO
            assert origin['commit'] == PIN if kind == 'official-git' else origin['commit'] in (HEAD,BASE,SOURCE)
            assert value == blob(origin['commit'],origin['path'],repo=upstream)
            blob_id = git('rev-parse',origin['commit']+':'+origin['path'],repo=upstream).decode().strip()
            assert hashlib.sha1(('blob '+str(len(value))+'\0').encode()+value).hexdigest() == blob_id
            verified.append({'member':name,'kind':kind,'commit':origin['commit'],'canonical_path':origin['path'],'git_blob_sha1':blob_id,'bytes':len(value),'sha256':sha(value)})
        elif kind == 'engineering-diff':
            assert tuple(origin['paths']) == SCOPE
            assert origin['before'] in [BASE]+COMMITS and origin['after'] in COMMITS
            assert value == git('diff','--binary','--full-index',origin['before'],origin['after'],'--',*SCOPE)
        elif kind == 'user-supplied-paper':
            suffix = PurePosixPath(name).suffix
            assert value == Path('/Users/lifeng/.zcode/workspace/default/2023.1788'+suffix).read_bytes()
        else:
            assert kind in ('generated-git-provenance','generated-provenance','current-final-review-task')
    engineering = tree(SOURCE,*SCOPE)
    historical_workflow = '.github/workflows/fb862a3-review-evidence.yml'

    assert len(engineering) == 28 and len(core_engineering) == 27
    selected_engineering = {p[len('project/'):] for p in data if p.startswith('project/') and (p[len('project/'):] == 'CMakeLists.txt' or p[len('project/'):].startswith(('src/','include/','tests/','.github/workflows/')))}
    assert selected_engineering == set(engineering)
    assert data['project/'+historical_workflow] == blob(BASE,historical_workflow)
    for p in engineering:
        assert data['project/'+p] == blob(SOURCE,p)
    official = [p for p in data if p.startswith('official-full/')]
    assert len(official) == 77
    stages = json.loads(data['history/STAGES.json'])
    assert [s['commit'] for s in stages] == COMMITS and [s['run'] for s in stages] == RUNS
    assert len([p for p in data if p.endswith('_JOB_01.log')]) == 12
    for s in stages:
        assert s['attempt'] == 1 and s['event'] == 'push'
        assert set(p['path'] for p in s['files']) == set(tree(s['commit'],*SCOPE))
        for p in s['files']:
            b = blob(s['commit'],p['path'])
            assert len(b) == p['bytes'] and sha(b) == p['sha256']
        for p in s['evidence']:
            assert p in data
        run_file = next(p for p in s['evidence'] if p.endswith('_RUN_FINAL_01.json'))
        run_obj = json.loads(data[run_file])
        assert run_obj.get('headSha',run_obj.get('source_commit')) == s['commit']
        assert run_obj.get('databaseId',run_obj.get('run_id')) == s['run']
        assert run_obj['event'] == 'push' and run_obj['attempt'] == 1 and run_obj['status'] == 'completed'
        assert run_obj['conclusion'] == ('failure' if 'red' in s['stage'] else 'success')
    legacy_dir = 'project/coordination/returns/lossless-client-io-pro-b64a980/'
    legacy_manifest = json.loads(data[legacy_dir+'MANIFEST.json'])
    legacy_keys = list(legacy_manifest)
    assert legacy_manifest['declaredNonSelfFileCount'] == len(legacy_manifest['files']) == 6
    for item in legacy_manifest['files']:
        old_data = data[legacy_dir+item['path']]
        assert item['path'].endswith('.md') and len(old_data) == item['bytes'] and sha(old_data) == item['sha256']
    assert set(n for n in data if n.startswith(legacy_dir)) == {legacy_dir+i['path'] for i in legacy_manifest['files']} | {legacy_dir+'MANIFEST.json'}
    assert not any(n.endswith('.zip') for n in data)
    assert data['TASK.md'] == (HERE/'TASK.md').read_bytes()
    brief = data['TASK.md'].decode()
    required = ['MANIFEST.json','SOURCE_IDENTITY.json','history/STAGES.json',
      'project/coordination/CORRECTNESS_ACCEPTANCE_SCOPE_20260905.md',
      'project/coordination/TEST_SEAMS.md',
      'project/coordination/tasks/LOSSLESS_CLIENT_IO_PRO_IMPLEMENTATION_01.md']
    assert all(p in data for p in required)
    assert 'MANIFEST_PLAN_01.json' not in brief
    assert 'provenance/stages/' not in brief

    old_citations = sorted(set(re.findall(r'official-openfhe/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.(?:h|cpp))','\n'.join(v.decode() for n,v in data.items() if n.startswith('project/') and n.endswith('.md')))))
